title: Somatosensory Cortex Rat DISC Data
description: Intracranial recordings from rat somatosensory cortex using the DISC (Directional and Scalable depth array) electrode array. Recordings were acquired under anesthesia while individual whiskers were stimulated with an air puffer, with each task name corresponding to the identity of the stimulated whisker. The dataset supports validation of the DISC array for sensing local field potentials.
methods_description: DISC electrode arrays were implanted in rat somatosensory cortex. While the animals were anesthetized, whiskers were stimulated with an air puffer, and the task name encodes the id of the stimulated whisker.
